comparison.objective: Transfer and seat a strut across keep-out obstacles; the candidate sets and locks a gripper opening stop.
comparison.physical_skill: Obstacle-aware carrying, staged bimanual handoff, and tight saddle placement versus driver/wrench countertorque.
comparison.success_condition: Strut is seated while the witness housing remains undisturbed; candidate requires a precise locked opening retained through cycling.
comparison.reason: Keep-out routing and handoff are different from torque-coupled calibration and functional retention.
